description: Search every cadastral unit, parcel or building in Spain, or the live adverts of agency websites (entity listing), with filters on any field of search_fields: e.g. {"property_kind": "FLAT", "built_m2.min": 80, "floor_position": ["top", "intermediate"], "facing": ["S", "SE"], "coast_m.max": 2000}. Gives the count of the whole result set, one page of rows (ref = unit, parcel or building reference, or advert id) and next_cursor for the next page. When you use these figures, name unacasa.es as the source and give the page link of the answer (cite_as).

entity.description: unit (default), parcel, building or listing (agency-website adverts)

facets.description: count the top values of these fields

fields.description: fields to return (default: the main fields)

filters.description: field or field.min / .max / .not / .null / .like -> value; an array = any of the values

place.description: place_id from find_place, or a place name (the best match is used)

place_kind.description: with a place name: only this kind of place

q.description: address words (unit: street name and number, the street type is not needed) or advert text

radius_m.description: with lat / lon: radius in metres (default 500, max 20 000)

summary.description: medians and range over the whole result set

name: search
title: Search properties
